rich2021ActivityMath: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L10 develops adaptive fraction addition strategies through TWO spinner games Greatest Sum and Smallest Sum. The spinner outcomes and placements are student dependent and must not be substituted with one fake publisher result.
Warm-up Number Talk printed fractions2/12+1/6=1/3,2/6+1/2=5/6,1/3+1/2=5/6,1/3+3/2=11/6. Children find equivalent denominator units and compare efficient representations.

Activity1 Greatest Sum: partner spins to fill four blank numerator/denominator slots, cannot erase a placed digit, computes sum, and the GREATER sum wins a round. After FOUR rounds majority of wins, ties broken by total of all four sums.

Activity2 Smallest Sum: same actual spinner-and-four-box process over four rounds but SMALLER sum wins each round, ties decided by smaller total of all round sums. Original source doesn't prescribe any roll sequence or fixed optimal numerical solution before rolls.

Previous authored numerical examples in Rich V2 remain distinct optional Edulytiks additions. Digital selected practice covers exact warm-up values and source rules; real spins, denominators, fairness, rationale, and correct scoring require teacher review.
